ghi_chu: So lieu dot thuc thi 10-11/09/2026. Moi con so do that bang ma trong repo; cot nguon ghi file sinh ra no. Bo sung cho facts_verified.json, khong thay the.

A_bang_kien_truc_v2.giao_thuc: dai 10-60 Hz, 5 fold tach ban ghi, val=others[0], nguong chon TREN VAL roi ap sang test, 20 (ban ghi x kenh), +/-50 ms, cua so 300 ms, 1 seed, 3 epoch, train_stride 2
A_bang_kien_truc_v2.ket_luan: Sau kien truc nam trong 1,5 diem, KHONG kien truc nao khac cnn_dil co y nghia (moi p >= 0,105). Chi gian no (cnn_m vs cnn_dil, cung tham so, p=0,0001) va linear la khac. Tat ca <= 92,43 so voi 97,43 cua mo hinh 4 s dau ra tung mau.
A_bang_kien_truc_v2.gioi_han: 1 seed, 3 epoch (loss van giam), bo transformer va hai bien the 2D vi qua cham; cnn_l/resnet1d/tcn chay lai rieng sau khi lan dau het RAM.

B_baseline_co_dien.tuning: sieu tham so chon CHI tren r01, ap nguyen cho 4 ban ghi con lai
B_baseline_co_dien.ket_luan: Mang dang +11,06 diem so voi lay dinh tren cung tin hieu du. TS-PCA tren kenh PSD dat 96,74, chi kem mo hinh 2,47 diem.
B_baseline_co_dien.power_mf: khong chay lai duoc: MATLAB, thieu 8 ham Varanini 2014, da kenh; ghi tai baselines/powermf_status.json

C_silesia.du_lieu: Matonia 2020 Sci Data 7:200, figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.4740794, CC0; zip 195,1 MB sha256 a7da9beefe1ce94f86ee99515848b8b853a44d1758cf30e7c7d87546536d77f6; .ecg int16 big-endian /10, 500 Hz, 4 kenh bung A1-A4

ro_ri.ket_luan: 5/12 ban ghi B2 CHINH LA 5 ban ghi PhysioNet -> so san phu doc lap = 22, khong phai 27
ro_ri.xu_ly: 5 ban ghi trung dung fold checkpoint; con lai dung production

B1_thai_ky.nhan: GIAN TIEP (khong co dien cuc da dau); lech he thong 8-12 ms o 5/10 ban ghi

C_silesia.ket_luan: Tong quat sang thai ky: 97 -> 93 (cung he ghi). Sang he ghi khac (CinC): 97 -> 59/77. Bien gay sup do la thiet bi/bo tri dien cuc, khong phai tuoi thai.

D_fsqi_C3.giao_thuc: nhan doan xau = F1 < 80 tren doan 4 s; train ADFECGDB (1500 doan, fold checkpoint) -> test CinC (600 doan, production); bootstrap 1000; 2 lan chay trung 1327/1327 truong
D_fsqi_C3.ket_luan: KET QUA PHU DINH cho dong dieu ben vung: AUROC 0,566 vs 0,929; gop vao con giam. Cong tu choi CO tac dung bang chi so co dien (+7,4 diem o do phu 80%). C3 phat bieu lai: cong tu choi tren do tu tin mo hinh + tinh hop ly nhip, kem ket qua phu dinh co kiem soat ve TDA.

E_demo.kiem_thu: pytest demo/test_core.py 8/8; smoke_app.py HTTP 200 + API /run F1 100,00 tren r01; run_check 16/16
E_demo.tinh_chat_quan_trong: Khong ban ghi nao den xanh ma F1 < 96,54. Sai duy nhat theo chieu than trong (r04 vang du F1 99,76).
